diff --git a/fastapi/openapi/utils.py b/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
index dbc93d28..ce5a2d9c 100644
--- a/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/openapi/utils.py
@@ -75,6 +75,29 @@ status_code_ranges: Dict[str, str] = {
 }
 
 
+def _merge_security_schemes(
+    target: Dict[str, Any], source: Dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    # The same security scheme can be used by several path operations with
+    # different OAuth2 scopes, merge them so none of the scopes is lost
+    for security_name, security_definition in source.items():
+        existing_definition = target.get(security_name)
+        if existing_definition is None:
+            target[security_name] = security_definition
+            continue
+        existing_flows = existing_definition.get("flows", {})
+        for flow_name, flow in security_definition.get("flows", {}).items():
+            if flow_name not in existing_flows:
+                existing_flows[flow_name] = flow
+                continue
+            existing_flow = existing_flows[flow_name]
+            if "scopes" in flow:
+                existing_flow["scopes"] = {
+                    **existing_flow.get("scopes", {}),
+                    **flow["scopes"],
+                }
+
+
 def get_openapi_security_definitions(
     flat_dependant: Dependant,
 ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], List[Dict[str, Any]]]:
@@ -87,7 +110,9 @@ def get_openapi_security_definitions(
             exclude_none=True,
         )
         security_name = security_requirement.security_scheme.scheme_name
-        security_definitions[security_name] = security_definition
+        _merge_security_schemes(
+            security_definitions, {security_name: security_definition}
+        )
         operation_security.append({security_name: security_requirement.scopes})
     return security_definitions, operation_security
 
@@ -280,7 +305,7 @@ def get_openapi_path(
             if operation_security:
                 operation.setdefault("security", []).extend(operation_security)
             if security_definitions:
-                security_schemes.update(security_definitions)
+                _merge_security_schemes(security_schemes, security_definitions)
             operation_parameters = _get_openapi_operation_parameters(
                 dependant=route.dependant,
                 model_name_map=model_name_map,
@@ -520,8 +545,9 @@ def get_openapi(
                 if path:
                     paths.setdefault(route.path_format, {}).update(path)
                 if security_schemes:
-                    components.setdefault("securitySchemes", {}).update(
-                        security_schemes
+                    _merge_security_schemes(
+                        components.setdefault("securitySchemes", {}),
+                        security_schemes,
                     )
                 if path_definitions:
                     definitions.update(path_definitions)
@@ -539,8 +565,9 @@ def get_openapi(
                 if path:
                     webhook_paths.setdefault(webhook.path_format, {}).update(path)
                 if security_schemes:
-                    components.setdefault("securitySchemes", {}).update(

                     )
                 if path_definitions:
